description: Change a payment dispute: pass dispute_id and at least one of status, reason (null clears it) and metadata. Move it to under review while you look into it and to resolved or rejected when you have decided. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

dispute_id.description: The dispute: its id, as list_disputes shows it.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

reason.description: Why it is disputed; null clears it.

name: update_dispute
